subject: Request: one-time capacity bundle concession for Adaptive Health
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodai.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@adaptive-health.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Adaptive Health — capacity bundle pricing ask

Hi Alex,

Great speaking yesterday — thanks for walking through the integration plan. Based on your expected ramp and the early pilot signals, I put together a starter \"Accelerator\" capacity bundle that maps to the cadence you described (6 months, burstable until month 3).

Given the strategic nature of the program (marketplace co-sell + references), I can offer a one-time concession on the starter bundle. My recommendation: a 35% one-time discount on the first 6 months of committed capacity, with a modest usage floor of 60% of the committed capacity across months 1–3. We would require a signed SOW and MA in order to apply the concession.

Attachments: Adaptive_Health_MA_plan_v1.pdf (draft MA), Adaptive_pricing_model_v2.xlsx (pro forma showing concession impact).

If that aligns, I'll escalate internally for VP/CFO sign-off and get a clean SOW over to you. Can you confirm: 1) total committed GPU hours for the 6-month bundle, 2) procurement lead contact and preferred invoice term (Net-30/Net-60)?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call with procurement if helpful.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodai.com
+1 (415) 555-0149

From: Alex Morgan <alex@adaptive-health.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Adaptive Health Procurement <procurement@adaptive-health.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Adaptive Health — capacity bundle pricing ask

Thanks Sofia — appreciate the fast follow.

Quick answers: the team is targeting 12,000 GPU hours over the first 6 months (ramped: 1k/mo, then 2k, 3k, 3k, 1k, 2k). Procurement is Tara Reynolds (procurement@adaptive-health.com) and they prefer Net-60 for new vendors while our legal is still onboarding.

I understand the need for an SOW. From our side, the ask is whether you can get closer to a 40% concession on the starter period — we are weighing two offers and pricing differential will be decisive. Also need confirmation that keys/data separation and SOC-2 evidence are provided before signing.

If you can put the 35% concession in writing and call out the ramp floor, procurement can evaluate the SOW + payment term trade-offs.

- Alex
VP, Engineering | Adaptive Health

Subject: Fwd: Adaptive Health — capacity bundle pricing ask (VP/CFO approval requested)

Ben / Marissa — forwarding a pricing escalation from Adaptive Health. Key facts: 6-month starter bundle (12k GPU hours total, ramp pattern below), external procurement requesting Net-60, and Alex pressing for a larger concession (aiming for ~40%).

Why this matters: Adaptive is a strategic vertical customer (healthcare marketplace integration + potential marketplace listing). We expect ~$1.2M ARR in year 1 if we secure the accelerator and they convert to a committed enterprise contract. They are also an attractive reference for payers/APIs in the same space.

My ask: approval to offer a one-time, time-bound concession structured as follows:
- Concession: 35% off list for months 1–6 applied to the defined starter bundle (no additional discounts on add-on hours).
- Conditions: signed SOW and MA prior to first invoice; usage floor 60% of committed capacity months 1–3; concession capped at $300k total revenue impact.
- Contractual: Legal sign-off on indemnity/PD terms, SOC-2 attestation copy on file, payment term consideration (we are okay to evaluate Net-60 for this strategic deal if finance signs off).

Attachments attached: Adaptive_Health_MA_plan_v1.pdf, Adaptive_pricing_model_v2.xlsx (impact modeling). I sketched expected ROI and churn risk in the model.

Timeline: customer would like written confirmation by EOD Tuesday (2027-07-12) to keep the procurement window open. Please advise if you approve, approve with modifications, or decline. If approved, I'll route to Legal to prepare the SOW and loop Finance for Net-60 approval.

Thanks,
Sofia

Team — after reviewing the attachment and the modelling, I approve the proposed one-time concession at 35% with the following hard constraints: 

1) Concession cap: total revenue concession must not exceed $300,000; if pro-forma projects greater, revert to me before committing.
2) Signed SOW & MA: must be in place and countersigned prior to application of discount. Legal to confirm standard indemnities and ensure there are no non-standard IP carveouts.
3) Finance to confirm Net-60 for this counterparty prior to acceptance; Marcus please run counterparty risk and confirm cash flow impact — if finance cannot sign off on Net-60, default to Net-30 and notify the AE.
4) Reference clause and exec sponsor: require a short-term executive sponsor commitment from Adaptive (email from CEO or Head of Partnerships) before concession applies.

If those conditions are met, Sofia — you have my approval to offer 35% on months 1–6 with the 60% usage floor and the $300k cap. Please copy Legal and Finance when you send the SOW to the customer, and put the concession terms in the SOW explicitly (dates, cap, floor).

Marissa Cole
Chief Financial Officer, Redwood Inference
